decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows on the front elevation shall be closed between the hours of 7.00 pm and not re-open until 8.00am the following morning.
Condition : 6 - The main entrance door, and the additional fire exit door on the front elevation to the premises shall be self-closing and will not be propped open.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the premise shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Installation of a new shop front with opening doors to existing restaurant.
